# Week 3: identification

## Instrumental variables

An instrument must move the treatment (relevance) and reach the outcome only
through the treatment (exclusion). Weak instruments bias the two stage estimate
toward ordinary least squares.

## Difference in differences

The estimate is credible only under parallel trends: without treatment both
groups would have moved together. Check pre-period trends with an event study.
